briefing.headline: OpenAI o3 multi-agent system sparks new AGI race acceleration

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with o3, Claude 4, and Gemini 2.5 pushing multi-agent capabilities. Global funding remains elevated amid regulatory scrutiny. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o3 with advanced reasoning chains. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 2.5 show gains in agent orchestration. Meta and xAI expanded open weights releases this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New vulnerabilities reported in production agents. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC securing additional capacity. Microsoft and Google expand data center builds in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems reach autonomous goal pursuit before 2028 safety standards are enforced?
